neighbours.label: the capitalized name piece 'Paw' (Pawar, Pawnee, Pawlenty, Pawtucket)
fire: The coach, Rahul Pawar, praised his players.
Many Pawnee families farmed along the river.
Reporters asked Tim Pawlenty about taxes.
The mill in Pawtucket closed in 1920.
The study was led by Dr. Sharad Pawar.
The old Pawnee trail crossed the valley.
Last spring, Pawlenty visited the factory.
The bus from Pawtucket arrived late.
quiet: The coach, Rahul Patel, praised his players.
Many Cherokee families farmed along the river.
Reporters asked Tim Walz about taxes.
The mill in Providence closed in 1920.
The study was led by Dr. Sharad Joshi.
The old Mohawk trail crossed the valley.
Last spring, Payne visited the factory.
The bus from Warwick arrived late.

notes: Card: ' Paw' x5, plus spaces before numbers. Probe: Pawar 0.75, Pawnee 0.50, Pawlenty 0.55, Pawtucket 0.71, lowercase paw ~0.
